coding_note: Two separately supplied coding sheets were compared; NemoFold does not verify that their raters worked independently.
reading_note: Percent agreement is misleading whenever one code dominates, which is why kappa stands next to it. Where kappa is undefined it says so rather than printing a number that would be read as a result. The disagreements are the output worth reading: they mark where the coding scheme is ambiguous, not where a rater was wrong.
